newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dyckerhoff 96 profit to exceed that in 94.
newsitem.headline: Dyckerhoff 96 profit to exceed that in 94.

text.p: German building group Dyckerhoff AG said on Friday its 1996 full-year net profit "would exceed that made in 1994".

The group's 1995 net profit was boosted to 452.4 million marks by a one-off gain of more than 300 million marks related to the adoption of International Accounting Standards. Net profit in 1994 stood at 114.47 million marks.
Dyckerhoff also said it expected its group turnover for 1996 to rise slightly to 2.5 billion marks.

The construction group said that following the adoption of IAS standards last year, it would be consolidating figures from associate groups in which it had a significant minority stake in proportion to the size of the stake held.
It said such a move, while increasing reported turnover, would have no significant effect on its net profit.
